name: Dependent List
description: Define conditional list fields where the options in field B depend on the value selected in field A on the same entity.
project_description: Dependent List makes a list field's options depend on the value chosen in another list field on the same entity. On an entity edit form the child field's options are filtered in real time via AJAX when the parent value changes. It works with list_string, list_integer and list_float fields, with select, radios and checkboxes widgets, and functions inside paragraphs and nested inline entity forms. Configuration is a per-field third-party setting (a parent field plus a parent-value -> allowed-child-keys map) edited in the field settings form; no separate admin page. Requires the core options and field_ui modules.
